svg.title: A LiteScope capture of the CPU instruction bus
svg.desc: Timing diagram of a LiteScope capture: sys_clk, ibus_cyc, ibus_stb, ibus_adr, ibus_ack and ibus_dat_r over fourteen cycles. cyc and stb rise together at the trigger, adr holds 0xfd8 until the first ack two cycles later, then 0xfd9, 0xfda and 0xfdb with one ack each: the CPU refills a cache line of four words, and dat_r carries each instruction word on its ack.

g.text: The capture, triggered on the rising edge of ibus_stb
the CPU fetches a cache line: four words from 0xfd8, one ack each (from dump.vcd)
